extracted.intended_audience: attorneys or former practitioners seeking reinstatement to practice before the United States Patent and Trademark Office; counsel handling reinstatement petitions
extracted.subtask_description: Evaluation and decision criteria used by the Office of Enrollment and Discipline for petitions to reinstate an individual to practice before the USPTO, focusing on compliance with regulatory provisions and the Director's discretionary review of the petition and record.

rubrics_metrics.name: Compliance with 37 CFR § 11.58
rubrics_metrics.description: "Mr. Lahser complied with all provisions of 37 CFR §  11.58 on or before June 3, 2017."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reinstatement requires compliance with the regulatory provisions set forth in 37 C.F.R. § 11.58. The decision cites the date by which compliance must be achieved (here, on or before June 3, 2017). The page does not recite the specific subsections of § 11.58, but treats full compliance with that regulation as a prerequisite for consideration of reinstatement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Filing of a Petition for Reinstatement
rubrics_metrics.description: "Consideration has been given to the Petition for Reinstatement of Andrew P. Lahser received on May 1, 2017."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A petition must be submitted and is the initiating document for reinstatement consideration. The Office records the petition receipt date and uses the petition as the primary document for review. Timely filing and proper submission of the petition are implied procedural requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Director's review of petition and record material
rubrics_metrics.description: "After careful review of the Petition and all information in the record material to Mr. Lahser's eligibility for reinstatement, the Director ... has determined that reinstatement ... is appropriate."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Director of the Office of Enrollment and Discipline exercises discretionary authority to grant reinstatement after reviewing the petition and all relevant record material bearing on eligibility. The standard applied is a holistic review of the petition plus the record to determine whether reinstatement is appropriate.
